sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed misconduct handling capacity at the Department of Consumer Employment Protection.
sentences.support: It is part of a program of reviews to assess the ability of the Public Sector Agencies to deal with misconduct

sentences.text: The review considered internal investigations and the department's role in identifying suspected misconduct elsewhere in the public sector.
sentences.support: It is in a unique position to identify and notify the Commission of misconduct external to itself.

sentences.text: The Commission considered the department committed to misconduct guidelines, staff education and reporting obligations.
sentences.support: The Commission considers that DOCEP is making a very serious attempt to establish appropriate misconduct guidelines for its staff

sentences.text: Its two recommendations sought monitoring of internal investigation capacity and continued notification of suspected misconduct outside the department.
sentences.support: The Commission has made two recommendations in this report

findings.quote: The Commission considers that DOCEP is making a very serious attempt to establish appropriate misconduct guidelines for its staff, to roll out those guidelines in a timely fashion and to educate the Executive and staff about their obligations and responsibilities under the Act.
